The perturbation scheme

Starting from P_0=P, the construction (eq:viteration) sets P_{k+1} = P_k + \alpha_k\,(\mathcal R_k p_k)\,w_k,\qquad p_k=y_k^*\circ P_k,\quad w_k=\frac{P_k(x_k)}{\|P_k(x_k)\|}, where x_k almost norms P_k, f_k is a norming functional of x_k, and y_k^* norms P_k(x_k). Polynomials are represented by their symmetric n-linear forms. The module proves the norm increments (eq:increment) and bounds (eq:normbounds).

The data (x_k, f_k, y_k^*) chosen at a stage.

abbrev Choice (𝕜 X Y : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] := X × StrongDual 𝕜 X × StrongDual 𝕜 Y

Requirements on the choice made for P with tolerance δ.

structure Good (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (δ : ℝ) (t : Choice 𝕜 X Y) : Prop where norm_x : ‖t.1‖ = 1 near : polyNorm (diag P) - δ ≤ ‖diag P t.1‖ norm_f : ‖t.2.1‖ = 1 f_x : t.2.1 t.1 = 1 norm_g : ‖t.2.2‖ ≤ 1 g_P : t.2.2 (diag P t.1) = ((‖diag P t.1‖ : ℝ) : 𝕜)

The choice made at a stage.

def pick (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (δ : ℝ) : Choice 𝕜 X Y := Classical.epsilon (Good P δ)
lemma pick_good [Nontrivial X] (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : Good P δ (pick P δ) := Classical.epsilon_spec (exists_good P hδ)

w = P(x)/‖P(x)‖.

def wvec (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (t : Choice 𝕜 X Y) : Y := ((‖diag P t.1‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • diag P t.1

One step of the construction (eq:viteration).

def stepMap (α δ : ℝ) (P : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1) := P + ((α : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (Rop (pick P δ).1 (pick P δ).2.1 ((pick P δ).2.2.compContinuousMultilinearMap P)).smulRight (wvec P (pick P δ))

The sequence P_k.

def seqP (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (a : ℝ) : ℕ → MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1) | 0 => A | k + 1 => stepMap (alpha a k) (alpha a k ^ 2) (seqP A a k)
variable (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (a : ℝ)

M_k = ‖P_k‖.

def seqM (k : ℕ) : ℝ := polyNorm (diag (seqP A a k))

The choice at stage k.

def seqT (k : ℕ) : Choice 𝕜 X Y := pick (seqP A a k) (alpha a k ^ 2)

x_k.

def seqx (k : ℕ) : X := (seqT A a k).1

f_k.

def seqf (k : ℕ) : StrongDual 𝕜 X := (seqT A a k).2.1

y_k^*.

def seqg (k : ℕ) : StrongDual 𝕜 Y := (seqT A a k).2.2

w_k.

def seqw (k : ℕ) : Y := wvec (seqP A a k) (seqT A a k)
lemma seqP_succ (k : ℕ) : seqP A a (k + 1) = seqP A a k + ((alpha a k : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (Rop (seqx A a k) (seqf A a k) ((seqg A a k).compContinuousMultilinearMap (seqP A a k))).smulRight (seqw A a k) :=
